stories.title: Jeremiah's Call
stories.summary: The LORD calls Jeremiah as a young man to be a prophet to the nations. He is shown an almond branch and a boiling pot and told not to fear.

stories.title: The Potter's House and the Broken Jar
stories.summary: Jeremiah watches a potter remake a spoiled vessel, then breaks a clay jar in the Valley of Hinnom to announce coming destruction.

stories.title: Jeremiah and Pashhur; the Temple Sermon
stories.summary: The priest Pashhur has Jeremiah beaten and put in the stocks. Jeremiah complains bitterly about his calling.

stories.title: Hananiah's False Prophecy
stories.summary: Hananiah breaks the yoke Jeremiah wears and says Babylon's rule will end in two years. Jeremiah answers that the yoke will be iron, and Hananiah dies that year.

stories.title: The Scroll Burned
stories.summary: Baruch writes down Jeremiah's words and reads them in the temple. King Jehoiakim cuts the scroll and burns it, and Jeremiah dictates it again with additions.

stories.title: Jeremiah in the Cistern
stories.summary: During the siege Jeremiah is arrested and lowered into a muddy cistern. Ebed-melech the Cushite pulls him out, and Zedekiah consults him privately.

stories.title: The Fall of Jerusalem and Flight to Egypt
stories.summary: Babylon captures Jerusalem and Jeremiah is freed. After Gedaliah is killed, the survivors ignore Jeremiah's warning and flee to Egypt, taking him with them.
